description: Show or select the board storage backend
Make this repo use a board so --board can be omitted
List boards and mark the one this directory uses
Compare the published state.json hash with the last push

If it reports diverged, stop and ask the user; --overwrite replaces the other writer's board on the next push.

description: Merge a downloaded state.json into the local board
note: This is the deliberate, token-costly path: it needs read_file of state.json first. If it stops on a conflict, ask the user which side wins.

note: This prints claude-artifacts tool calls (list_files, publish_files, read_file); make them exactly as printed, then run the follow-up line it prints. Never read or summarize the board data.
